newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING Barings cuts KNP BT to a Hold.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings cuts KNP BT to a Hold.

text.p: ING Barings said on Thursday it had downgraded its recommendation for paper and packaging group KNP BT to a Hold from a Buy.
It said the company had again published a disappointing statement forecasting that profits would recover this year but that the first quarter would lag behind the year-ago period.
ING Barings said the paper market was still nervously anticipating new production capacity coming on stream in the second half of 1997 and prices were showing great volatility.

"The risks involved in the paper production are still quite high, as the paper market could show real signs of weakness around the summer period," ING Barings said, adding that weaker demand could send prices back to early 1996 levels.
ING Barings cut its forecast of KNP BT's 1997 earnings per share to 3.25 guilders from 3.75 and kept its EPS forecast for 1998 at 4.50 guilders for the time being.
"Given the lingering high risks of the paper market, we have downgraded the stock to a Hold," ING Barings said.
